text: West Plains native Stan Utley was inducted into the Missouri Golf Hall of Fame, announced Oct. 26, for his career as a pro golfer, instructor and junior golf advocate. That's a fairway to remember.
Campaign finance reports show Republicans well funded for the final push in Missouri's tight legislative races, even as Democrats predict voter discontent will help them.
MoDOT picked rural interstate segments where the speed limit will rise from 70 to 75 mph under a new state law. Hold on to your hat.

Missouri's State Board of Education is divided over a plan to give every public school and district an A-through-F grade, and one member questioned whether it would help struggling schools. Even adults dread report cards.
Missouri's interim education commissioner, Stacey Preis, resigned Tuesday, effective immediately, as the board searches for a permanent leader. She'd held the job since June.
The Kansas City Chiefs improved to 5-0 with a 22-6 win over the Chargers, and Patrick Mahomes earned his 100th career win. Undefeated and still hungry.
No. 13 Missouri lost 31-3 at No. 9 Ole Miss, falling to 5-2 overall and 2-2 in the SEC despite two early drives inside the 10-yard line. Tigers will shake it off.
